_comment: Tài liệu GIẢ LẬP dùng làm fixture cho mọi ví dụ trong thư mục này. Nội dung do người soạn spec tự viết để minh hoạ định dạng; KHÔNG phản ánh nội dung thật của bất kỳ tác phẩm nào.

paragraphs.text: Welcome back, everyone. Before we start, a quick note about the schedule for the break.
The Solar Plexus is the center of emotional awareness. It is the only center in the body graph that works in waves rather than in a stable pattern.
Gate 55 and Gate 49 are connected through genetic transmission: what is carried in Gate 55 is expressed in the way Gate 49 responds to the world.
I remember a student who kept changing jobs every spring, and that is exactly how the wave shows up in daily life.
The Sleeping Phoenix cycle begins in 2027, and it will change how this center is perceived collectively.
Question from the audience: does this mean we should avoid decisions during the low part of the wave? Answer: not avoid, but wait for clarity.
